rejection_criteria: Family/version alignment or repository co-location without digest-bound build provenance.
Unbounded current environment, undocumented host state, or package metadata alone.
Receipt-only member observation with no producing-build link.
One-off proof that cannot govern update or rollback.
Token presence alone or partial recipe excerpts.
Assuming every Termux recipe change is runtime-required adaptation.
Package-wide inference from a recipe-level change.
Treating absence of collector tokens as proof of no adaptation.
SONAME equality of the provider object alone.
Copying the first-generation concrete filename as a permanent oracle.
Substituting a different ABI family such as libjpeg.so.8 for libjpeg.so.62.
